description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Shapeshifter Style, Shapeshifter Twist, Beast Shape or Wild Shape class feature

Benefit: While you are using Shapeshifter Style, if you use your beast shape or wild shape ability as a standard action, you can also make a single melee attack with one of your natural weapons at your highest base attack bonus against one foe within your reach.

system.requirements: Shapeshifter Style, Shapeshifter Twist, Beast Shape or Wild Shape class feature
